proposals.action_title: Launch 1st Premium KDP Coloring Book using Runware API
proposals.why_this_works_now: KDP organic traffic for specific niches (e.g., 'Gothic Fantasy Coloring Book') is highly active. Runware PAYG provides FLUX-schnell quality for $0.0006 per image, meaning a 40-page book costs less than $0.05 to generate, bypassing the GitHub Actions image bottleneck cleanly within the 20 EUR budget.
proposals.first_action_today: Fund Runware with 5 EUR, run the 'produce_coloring_book' pipeline via GitHub Actions using the Runware API, and compile the PDF.

proposals.action_title: Bulk Upload 50 Text-Based Stickers via Redbubble API/Termux
proposals.why_this_works_now: Text-based stickers (funny coding quotes, niche idioms) require zero complex GPU generation. They bypass the image generation bottleneck completely. Redbubble indexes new text designs rapidly, catching search traffic for trending memes or niche hobbies.
proposals.first_action_today: Run 'produce_quotes_minimal' to generate 50 transparent PNGs with high-contrast text, then batch upload them using a lightweight Python/Selenium script on Termux or manual upload templates.

proposals.action_title: Publish 5 Parametric 3D Printing Files on Cults3D
proposals.why_this_works_now: Cults3D is a high-conversion platform for functional 3D prints. Parametric utility designs (e.g., custom grid wall organizers, SD card holders) can be generated programmatically via OpenSCAD on GitHub Actions without any AI image generation issues. Hobbyists gladly pay 1.50 EUR to 3.00 EUR for a clean STL.
proposals.first_action_today: Activate the Cults3D account, render 3 variations of a functional desk organizer STL using OpenSCAD on Termux, and list them with clear descriptive tags.

proposals.action_title: Publish 3 Gamedev UI Asset Packs on Itch.io
proposals.why_this_works_now: Game developers constantly search itch.io for affordable UI kits (buttons, panels, icons). Together AI's free tier (FLUX-schnell) can generate high-quality fantasy or sci-fi UI elements. Itch.io allows instant, fee-free publishing and has strong internal discovery for asset packs.
proposals.first_action_today: Use Together AI free API to generate a set of 50 'Sci-Fi Hologram UI Buttons', package them in a ZIP with a license text file, and create an itch.io project page.

proposals.action_title: Upload 5 Hyper-Niche KDP Logbooks (No AI Images Required)
proposals.why_this_works_now: Low-content logbooks (e.g., 'Mycology Foraging Journal', 'Sourdough Starter Tracker') rely on interior grids generated via simple Python PDF libraries (ReportLab) on Termux. They require zero AI image generation for interiors, and cover designs can be minimalist text/vectors, avoiding API costs entirely.
proposals.first_action_today: Run 'produce_lowcontent_kdp' to generate a specialized interior PDF for a niche hobby logbook, design a clean text-based cover layout, and publish to KDP.
